title: Ever watched a horror show and wanted to live in the mansion with all the deeply fucked-up witches? I’m making that game.
author: NoAssociation6641
selftext:
I wanted the mansion. The sisterhood. The forbidden rooms. The beautiful clothes and absolutely unforgivable behaviour.

And I wanted to walk through the front door and actually live in that world.  
So I’m making Coven, a supernatural horror game set in New Orleans.

A witch academy in a sprawling mansion. Black magic behind a hair salon. Something waiting in the attic across town. A haunted house that keeps your ghost if you die inside.

Learn forbidden powers. Throw someone across a room without touching them. Descend into another witch’s personal hell, take her hand, and bring her home.  
Or master all seven magical arts. Kill the Supreme and take the crown.

Or pick the Antichrist and end the world for everybody. A nuclear flash. Red sky. Ash. The witches you’ve turned against trying to turn back time and erase you before you were ever born.

That’s what I’m building: being one of the dangerous people in a beautiful, deeply fucked-up place, with reasons to save the other witches—and reasons to fear them.

Here’s five minutes of gameplay from the current build. Still in development, but this is my introduction to Coven.
